description: This file defines the QuestionnaireForm class, which extends an abstract form processor to build, validate, and save responses to a questionnaire within the Goteo project. It handles dynamic form creation based on questionnaire questions, processes input data, and manages related answer records.

classes.name: QuestionnaireForm
classes.description: A form processor class responsible for dynamically creating questionnaire forms, validating user responses, and saving answers to the database within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Builds the questionnaire form dynamically based on the questionnaire's questions, setting form types and attributes.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and processes form data to create or update answer records associated with the questionnaire responses.
